event_name: Date 01 September 2019 Time 18:00 2019 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 29 August - 1 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 41 & 42) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Forcing another driver off the track.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 11 (Sergio Perez), the driver of car 23 (Alexander Albon) and team representatives. PER said he had not realized ALB was moving to overtake on the right as earlier he thought he would overtake on the left. ALB achieved an initial overlap with all 4 wheels on the track, but as PER moved to his right ALB put 2 wheels on the grass verge. ALB kept on with his overtaking move. PER said when he knew he was on his right he moved to his left. ALB successfully overtook PER. Each driver described it as hard racing and agreed there was potential danger. In view of the explanations and the successful overtaking move it was considered there should be no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 11 Alleged Forcing A Driver Off The Track
